raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview
Update DeepGEMM to the top of this PR https://github.com/vllm-project/DeepGEMM/pull/35.

The current DeepGEMM pin computes balanced SM locality domains during deep_gemm initialization. On a 60-SM MIG device, that reaches an existing balancing error during vLLM import, even when locality features are unused (see https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59482#issuecomment-6150173498). This PR updates both the CMake dependency and standalone installer to cleonard530/DeepGEMM@6af2d3a, which restores lazy C++ locality initialization using stable PyTorch APIs.
~~The legacy balancing issue remains and can still surface when balanced locality domains are requested.~~ 


cc @Harry-Chen @janeyx99 @khluu


---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [ ] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [ ] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [ ] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>
